model_selection_basis: local models_cache description: Fast and affordable agentic coding model; supported_in_api=true; default medium
routing_constraints: do not start a service, TUI, RPC, or model in this preparation

source_findings.finding: startup_model uses config.model when present; model/list default is only used when config.model is absent
bootstrap reads configured model and exports model_reasoning_effort in session config
TUI loads the layered config using cwd context before startup
ordinary positional PROMPT is the supported initial task input

effective_config_verification.method: fixed 0.154 app-server config/read over the existing private UDS
required_assertions: effective model source is the project layer or its resolved project config layer
no profile, managed requirement, or fallback layer replaces Luna
the selected service remains the ordinary default UDS/Embedded service

standalone_callback_note: A future standalone turn/start may explicitly carry model=gpt-5.6-luna as a callback safeguard, but the existing helper has no model parameter and must not be changed in this preparation.
